context_and_flow.screen_type: Mobile app login process with an overlay dialog requesting biometric setup.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Persuade the user to enable biometric authentication for faster login.
ux_patterns: The modal contains a fingerprint icon representing biometrics, placed above the title, acting as a visual cue to reinforce security.
The modal uses a clear hierarchy: header, body copy, and binary choices (cancel/confirm).
The background is dimmed to place focus on the modal dialog.
High contrast text and clear touch targets are present.
The fingerprint illustration is stylized, abstract, and monochromatic, serving as an icon/informative graphic rather than a decorative image.
